We've been piling customers' bodies in the back room for years&mdash;but I guess that's all over now.|A drunk [[Wyle Ulbreck]] accuses the Junix's Joint bartender|<ref name="Kenobi (novel)">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>}}
A [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bartender''' worked at the [[Junix's Joint]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Yoona]], who also worked at the cantina. The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] encountered the self-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] shortly after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived on Tatooine.
